priority_1.session_title: Zone 2 Aerobic Re-Entry Run with Strides
priority_1.workout_details: 45 Minutes Total: 10 min Z1/Z2 warm-up, 25 min steady Zone 2 running (HR < 150 BPM), 6 x 15-second fast, relaxed strides on flat road/grass (full 45s walk recovery), 5 min cool-down.
priority_1.reason: Highest priority to safely kickstart your acute training load after 12 days of rest. Adheres to the 70% aerobic base rule while priming turnover.

priority_2.reason: Directly targets your 20-minute power goal with low impact on joint structures, taking advantage of your fresh TSB.
